verdict.rationale: Metronome documents a first-party data export that sends sandbox and production data directly to your data warehouse, which supports taking your data elsewhere. The evidence does not show that the export covers all data, that it uses open formats, or that offboarding is supported; paginated list APIs are only building blocks. Missing for 10: confirmation that the export covers all data objects, documented open file formats (e.g. CSV/Parquet), explicit offboarding/portability guidance, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Metronome can send your sandbox and production data directly to your data warehouse, giving you the flexibility to build reports and dashboards with your favorite data tools.
